spec.summary: A bakery owner describes rebuilding after a fire, and what the first week taught them about customers. It is a practical account of deciding what to keep.
spec.description: How a bakery came back from a fire by calling every customer first.

body.title: 1/ So take me back to the morning it happened.

variants.text:
1/ So take me back to the morning it happened.

———

2/ The strange thing is that I felt calm, because there was nothing left to protect.

———

3/ Forty one calls, and thirty eight of them said they would wait for us.

———

4/ The insurer could wait a day, but a customer who hears nothing starts looking elsewhere.

———

5/ We paid them in bread, which is the best deal I have ever made.
